inputs.description: A tensor, the tensor to be updated.

indices.description: A tensor or list/tuple of shape `(N, inputs.ndim)`, specifying indices to update. `N` is the number of indices to update, must be equal to the first dimension of `updates`.

updates.description: A tensor, the new values to be put to `inputs` at `indices`.

output.description: A tensor, has the same shape and dtype as `inputs`.
